# Sir Philip Bailhache

Sir Philip Bailhache is the current Deputy of [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8) and a member of [Advance Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/advance-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 1972.

Sir Philip Bailhache has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-bailhache#e16)

  Elected as Senator with 62.1% of the ballot.
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-bailhache#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 55.2% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/philip-bailhache-2/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20150114052020/http://www.philipbailhache.je/my-manifesto/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Of3Rfs4xPmc)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-bailhache#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 8 with 50.4% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/philip-bailhache/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=16x1D94UW9g)
